subject: ESL
title: English Pronunciation for ITAs
info: Approved for S/U grading. Prerequisite: Placement based on SPEAK.

sections.sectionText: Priority is given to potential ITAs. No new students admitted after the third class meeting. Contact Suzanne Franks (scfranks@illinois.edu) for more information. Sounds, rhythm, and melody of spoken English for potential international teaching assistants. Includes word and phrase level study; special emphasis on the pronunciation of English vocabulary in students' own academic disciplines. Approved for S/U grading.
